headline: Callahans Passage Wholly Colonial; Fishermans Row Aflame Anew
war_summary: Since our last edition, the blank left at The Latch has been filled: Callahans Passage now flies entirely Colonial colors, and its butcher's bill redoubles — near five hundred Colonial and three hundred seventy Warden fallen in the latest hour, the war's steepest. Fishermans Row has rekindled after its lull, forty-nine base actions in a day with Peripti Landing and Arcadia the busiest posts and ownership seesawing nineteen times. Stonecradle burns on, better than nine hundred casualties in two hours since The Long Fast passed to Colonial hands, while Weathered Expanse grinds steadily — thirty-five actions, Necropolis fought over twenty times. Stlican Shelf stays hot about The Old Mourn, Warden losses there climbing, and the Dead Lands cool a shade yet Callahan's Boot remains contested. Tempest Island, Oarbreaker and Lykos Isle show no fresh fighting since our filing. The ledger now reads some two hundred sixty-five Colonial works against one hundred sixty-eight Warden, with but one base in ruin, at Godcrofts, the earlier blanks filled. It is the war's one-hundred-thirty-seventh day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
